v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Psalterio secundum diem

text.la: Fílii Sion * exsúltent in Rege suo.
text.en: Let the children of Sion * be joyful in their king.

text.la: Quam magnificáta * sunt ópera tua, Dómine.
text.en: O Lord, * how great are thy works!

text.la: Lætábitur iustus * in Dómino et sperábit in eo.
text.en: The just shall rejoice * in the Lord, and shall hope in him.

text.la: Osténde nobis, Dómine, * lucem miseratiónum tuárum.
text.en: Show us, O Lord, * the light of thy mercies.
Let every thing that hath breath * praise the Lord.

text.la: Ecce sacérdos magnus, qui in diébus suis plácuit Deo, et invéntus est iustus: et in témpore iracúndiæ factus est reconciliátio.
text.en: Behold an high priest, who in his days pleased God, and was found righteous, and in the time of wrath he was made a propitiation.

v.la: Iustum dedúxit Dóminus per vias rectas.
v.en: The Lord guided the just in right paths.

r.en: And showed him the kingdom of God.

text.la: Euge, serve bone * et fidélis, quia in pauca fuísti fidélis, supra multa te constítuam, dicit Dóminus.
text.en: Well done, thou good and faithful servant * thou hast been faithful over a few things, I will make thee ruler over many things, saith the Lord.

text.la: Deus, qui beátum Titum Confessórem tuum atque Pontíficem apostólicis virtútibus decorásti: eius méritis et intercessióne concéde; ut iuste et pie vivéntes in hoc sǽculo, ad cæléstem pátriam perveníre mereámur.
text.en: O God, Who didst glorify thy blessed Confessor and Bishop Titus with the graces of an Apostle, grant unto us for his sake and at his prayers, that we may so live soberly, righteously, and godly in this present world, that hereafter we may worthily attain unto the Fatherland which is in heaven.

text.la: Símile est regnum cælórum hómini negotiatóri quærénti bonas margarítas: invénta una pretiósa, dedit ómnia sua, et comparávit eam.
text.en: The kingdom of heaven is like unto a merchantman seeking goodly pearls, who, when he had found one pearl of great price, went and sold all that he had, and bought it.

v.la: Diffúsa est grátia in lábiis tuis.
v.en: Grace is poured into thy lips.

r.la: Proptérea benedíxit te Deus in ætérnum.
r.en: Therefore God hath blessed thee for ever.

text.la: Indulgéntiam nobis, quǽsumus, Dómine, beáta Doróthea Virgo et Martyr implóret: quæ tibi grata semper éxstitit, et mérito castitátis, et tuæ professióne virtútis.
text.en: O Lord, we pray thee, that thy blessed handmaiden and witness Dorothy in whom Thou hast ever been well pleased, because of her worthy maidenhood and her mighty showing-forth of thy power, may entreat thy pardon on our behalf.
